info.name: AccessHub - Workflow Tests
info.description: Run all folders in order with the AccessHub Local environment. Covers approval, return/resubmission, rejection, validation, CSRF, login/logout, and access control. Automatically switches demo accounts using explicit login requests and refreshes CSRF before each write. Creates three real requests and ends them approved/rejected. Re-running creates new records; existing requests are never deleted. Requires the dev profile and seeded demo accounts. Keep Postman cookie handling enabled.
